title: Mokoro Polling
summary: A slim dugout on a channel of reeds and water lilies: stand at the stern and push the pole, left then right, to keep the line straight.
howToPlay: Watch the ring close on the pad and press the moment it meets the pad.
Alternate sides with every beat; two pushes on one side turn you off line.
Keep the rhythm through the shallow patch and past the marker.
rules: A stroke on the beat gives a full push; off-beat strokes spend strength and give almost nothing.
Rough water shrinks the timing window.
Stars: first with a steady rhythm for three; first alone for two; on the podium for one.
heritageNote: The mokoro is a dugout poled through the shallow channels of the Okavango delta. The poler stands at the stern and sets the pace with a long push on every stroke.
